exposure: attending a brief antenatal lifestyle education seminar
timing of antenatal seminar attendance (first trimester vs. second trimester or later vs. no attendance)
cohort: 3008 eligible women receiving antenatal care at a hospital-based center in Beijing, China.
finding: Attending a brief antenatal lifestyle education seminar was associated with a lower risk of preterm birth, with first-trimester attendance showing a greater reduction in risk compared to later attendance.
